description: Phase-1.5 sim-realism diagnostic (F-1.5.2): per-feature distribution overlay of the synthetic bank vs unlabeled IAFDB, one panel per egm-features bundle feature, each annotated with the synthetic-vs-IAFDB KS distance. Shows where the synthetic feature distributions misalign with real recordings. Label-free (signal-level features only). Renders via the 'feature-distribution-overlay' recipe.
